description: Get a block by state hash or height. Defaults to a "lite" summary (header + transaction counts) that stays within the tool budget; use detail to pull paged transactions or the full block. In tutorial mode, queries the live daemon first and falls back to the archive DB. In live mode, a stateHash is required (use get_archive_blocks to discover one).

detail.description: Output size. "lite" (default): block header + transaction counts only — always within budget. "transactions": header + a page of userCommands (see transactionLimit/Offset). "full": the complete daemon response — may overflow the tool budget on busy networks.

transactionLimit.description: Max userCommands to return when detail="transactions".

transactionOffset.description: Offset into the userCommands list when detail="transactions".

name: get_block
